objects.description: Opaque streaming compression state for LZ4. Public API treats it as an incomplete type; concrete layout is provided later in this header strictly to allow static allocation. Do not access fields directly; layout may change.
Internal implementation structure for LZ4_stream_t containing hash table, dictionary pointers, and control fields. Not API/ABI stable; use only via LZ4_stream_t and public functions.
Opaque streaming decompression tracking context. Exposed as an incomplete type in the public API; concrete layout is provided to allow static allocation only. Do not access fields directly.
Internal implementation structure for LZ4_streamDecode_t storing pointers and sizes for external dictionary and decoded prefix. Not API/ABI stable; access only through public API.
Integer typedefs used internally for fixed-width and byte-sized values. LZ4_i8 is a signed 8-bit integer typedef (or signed char fallback).

objects.description: Unsigned 8-bit byte typedef used throughout internal structs and APIs for buffers and dictionary pointers.

objects.definition: typedef union LZ4_streamHC_u LZ4_streamHC_t;
objects.description: Opaque handle type for LZ4 high-compression streaming context/state. It is an incomplete type alias to an internal union and is used by the public streaming API. Must be created via LZ4_createStreamHC() or initialized over user-provided storage with LZ4_initStreamHC().

Internal, private structure implementing the HC compression context. Contains hash/chain tables, dictionary and prefix pointers, limits, tuning flags, and optional reference to another context for dictionary attachment. Exposed only for static allocation details; not part of the stable public API and subject to change.

Concrete union backing the opaque LZ4_streamHC_t. Provides a fixed-size byte array to ensure binary-size compatibility across versions and an internal context member used by the implementation. Intended for static allocation only; do not access fields directly in application code.

objects.definition: typedef size_t LZ4F_errorCode_t;
objects.description: Alias for size_t used to carry either a valid size/result or an error code from LZ4F APIs. Test with LZ4F_isError() and convert to names with LZ4F_getErrorName().

objects.description: Enumeration selecting the maximum block size used in a frame. Larger blocks may compress slightly better but use more memory.
Enumeration of block dependency mode: linked (better compression, needs history) or independent (random-access friendly).
Enable/disable 32-bit checksum of the decompressed content at end of frame.
Enable/disable per-block checksum of compressed block data.
Type of frame: standard LZ4 frame or skippable frame.
Holds frame parameters for compression or as output from parsing a frame header during decompression.

No structs, enums, typedefs, or classes are defined in this header. All type definitions are provided by the included lz4frame.h when LZ4F_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY is defined. Types merely referenced via inclusion are out of scope per instructions.

objects.description: Opaque handle type for reading/decompressing from an LZ4 file via this API. The underlying struct LZ4_readFile_s is forward-declared only (no definition here), making this an incomplete, opaque type managed through the provided functions.

objects.definition: typedef struct LZ4_writeFile_s LZ4_writeFile_t;
objects.description: Opaque handle type for writing/compressing to an LZ4 file via this API. The underlying struct LZ4_writeFile_s is forward-declared only (no definition here), making this an incomplete, opaque type managed through the provided functions.

functions.name: LZ4_versionNumber
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_versionNumber(void);
functions.description: Returns the library version number as an integer (requires v1.3.0+). Useful to verify the loaded DLL/shared object version at runtime.
requirements: No arguments.
Return value is an integer version code (major*100*100 + minor*100 + release).

functions.name: LZ4_versionString
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API const char* LZ4_versionString(void);
functions.description: Returns a null-terminated string with the library version (requires v1.7.5+). Useful for logging and diagnostics.
requirements: No arguments.
Returned pointer refers to static storage that must not be freed or modified.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_default
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_compress_default(const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity);
functions.description: Compresses src buffer into dst. Succeeds if dstCapacity >= LZ4_compressBound(srcSize); otherwise may return 0 and leave dst undefined.
requirements: src must point to srcSize bytes readable.
dst must point to an already-allocated buffer of size dstCapacity.
srcSize must be <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE (0x7E000000).
dstCapacity must be >= 1; compression guaranteed if >= LZ4_compressBound(srcSize).
On failure (return 0), dst content is invalid and must not be used.
Function never reads/writes out of provided buffers.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_safe
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decompress_safe(const char* src, char* dst, int compressedSize, int dstCapacity);
functions.description: Safely decompresses a single LZ4 block from src to dst. Returns decompressed size or a negative error if malformed input or dst too small.
requirements: src must contain exactly one complete compressed block of size compressedSize bytes.
dst must be an already-allocated buffer of size dstCapacity, an upper bound of decompressed size.
compressedSize and dstCapacity must be provided externally; they are not stored in the block.
Never writes outside dst or reads outside src; returns negative on error.

functions.name: LZ4_compressBound
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_compressBound(int inputSize);
functions.description: Returns the maximum compressed size for a given input size (worst-case). Useful for allocating destination buffers.
requirements: inputSize must be 0..LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE; returns 0 if invalid (too large or negative).

functions.name: LZ4_compress_fast
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_compress_fast(const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity, int acceleration);
functions.description: Like LZ4_compress_default but with an acceleration parameter controlling speed vs. ratio (higher is faster, lower ratio).
requirements: src/dst buffers and sizes as per LZ4_compress_default.
acceleration <= 0 is replaced by default (1).
acceleration > LZ4_ACCELERATION_MAX is clamped to LZ4_ACCELERATION_MAX.
Returns 0 if output cannot fit in dstCapacity.

functions.name: LZ4_sizeofState
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_sizeofState(void);
functions.description: Returns the number of bytes required for an external compression state buffer used by LZ4_compress_fast_extState and related APIs.
requirements: No arguments.
Returned size should be used to allocate an 8-byte aligned buffer for state.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_fast_extState
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_compress_fast_extState(void* state, const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity, int acceleration);
functions.description: Compresses using a caller-provided state buffer (avoids internal allocations). Behavior similar to LZ4_compress_fast.
requirements: state must point to a buffer of at least LZ4_sizeofState() bytes and be 8-byte aligned.
src/dst buffers and sizes as per LZ4_compress_default.
acceleration semantics as in LZ4_compress_fast.
Returns 0 if output cannot fit in dstCapacity.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_destSize
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_compress_destSize(const char* src, char* dst, int* srcSizePtr, int targetDstSize);
functions.description: Compresses as much input as possible into a fixed-size dst buffer. Updates *srcSizePtr with the number of input bytes consumed. Returns number of bytes written to dst or 0 on failure. Acceleration is default.
requirements: dst must have at least targetDstSize bytes (targetDstSize >= 1).
src must have at least *srcSizePtr bytes available; on return *srcSizePtr <= original value and indicates bytes consumed.
For versions v1.8.2 to v1.9.1, decompression might require dstCapacity > decompressedSize by at least 1 byte; update to v1.9.2+ or ensure margin as noted.
Returns 0 on failure; dst content unspecified on failure.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_safe_partial
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decompress_safe_partial(const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int targetOutputSize, int dstCapacity);
functions.description: Partially decompresses a block up to targetOutputSize bytes into dst, stopping once that many output bytes are produced or block ends. Returns bytes decoded or negative on malformed input.
requirements: dstCapacity must be >= targetOutputSize.
If srcSize is exact compressed block size, targetOutputSize can be any value (even larger than decompressed size).
If srcSize is larger than the block’s compressed size, targetOutputSize must be <= block’s decompressed size to avoid silent corruption.
Never writes beyond dstCapacity; may return < targetOutputSize if block decompresses to fewer bytes.

functions.name: LZ4_createStream
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API LZ4_stream_t* LZ4_createStream(void);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a streaming compression context for use with streaming APIs (e.g., LZ4_compress_fast_continue).
requirements: Available only when dynamic allocation isn’t disabled (i.e., !LZ4_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY_DISABLE_MEMORY_ALLOCATION).
Returns NULL on allocation failure; must be freed with LZ4_freeStream().

functions.name: LZ4_freeStream
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_freeStream(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr);
functions.description: Frees a streaming compression context created by LZ4_createStream().
requirements: streamPtr must be a pointer returned by LZ4_createStream() or NULL.
Available only when dynamic allocation isn’t disabled.
Return value: implementation-defined (commonly 0), check for success per library convention.

functions.name: LZ4_resetStream_fast
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API void LZ4_resetStream_fast(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr);
functions.description: Quickly resets a streaming compression context for a new chain of dependent blocks. Much faster than full initialization; requires the context to be already correctly initialized.
requirements: streamPtr must point to an LZ4_stream_t that has been initialized (e.g., via LZ4_createStream() or LZ4_initStream()).
Call before starting a new stream of dependent blocks.
Only useful for streaming compression; extState functions do their own resets.
Not compatible with uninitialized/garbage memory regions.

functions.name: LZ4_loadDict
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_loadDict(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr, const char* dictionary, int dictSize);
functions.description: Loads a dictionary into a streaming compression context, resetting prior history. Improves compression for small inputs. Only the last 64 KB are actually loaded.
requirements: streamPtr must be a valid initialized LZ4_stream_t.
dictionary must remain available and unmodified during compression using this stream.
dictSize can be 0 (equivalent to reset).
The same dictionary must be used at decompression for correct decoding.

functions.name: LZ4_loadDictSlow
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_loadDictSlow(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr, const char* dictionary, int dictSize);
functions.description: Like LZ4_loadDict but spends more CPU to reference the dictionary more thoroughly for slightly better compression ratio. Only last 64 KB are loaded.
requirements: Same as LZ4_loadDict: valid initialized streamPtr; dictionary must remain stable during compression; dictSize >= 0.

functions.name: LZ4_attach_dictionary
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API void LZ4_attach_dictionary(LZ4_stream_t* workingStream, const LZ4_stream_t* dictionaryStream);
functions.description: Attaches a preloaded dictionary stream to a working compression stream without copying, for efficient reuse across sessions. The attachment lasts through the next compression call and is then cleared.
requirements: workingStream must be a valid initialized LZ4_stream_t.
dictionaryStream should be a stream prepared by LZ4_loadDict() or LZ4_loadDictSlow(), or NULL to detach.
If a dictionary is provided, it replaces pre-existing stream history for the next compression call.
dictionaryStream and its source buffer must remain accessible and unchanged until the first subsequent compression completes.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_fast_continue
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_compress_fast_continue(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr, const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity, int acceleration);
functions.description: Compresses src using history from previous blocks in the same stream, producing an independent compressed block. Returns compressed size or 0 if it doesn’t fit in dstCapacity.
requirements: streamPtr must be a valid streaming context, initialized and properly reset between independent streams.
dst must be preallocated with size dstCapacity; recommend >= LZ4_compressBound(srcSize) for guaranteed success.
The previous 64 KB of source data are assumed to remain present and unmodified at the same memory address.
For double-buffer designs, ensure buffers are separated by at least 1 byte to keep block dependencies correct.
After an error (0 return), the stream is invalid and must be reset or freed before reuse.
acceleration semantics as in LZ4_compress_fast.

functions.name: LZ4_saveDict
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_saveDict(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr, char* safeBuffer, int maxDictSize);
functions.description: Saves up to the last 64 KB of stream history into safeBuffer for later reuse (faster than memcpy + LZ4_loadDict). Returns number of bytes saved or 0 on error.
requirements: streamPtr must be a valid streaming context.
safeBuffer must point to a writable buffer of size >= maxDictSize.
maxDictSize >= 0; returned size is <= maxDictSize.

functions.name: LZ4_createStreamDecode
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API LZ4_streamDecode_t* LZ4_createStreamDecode(void);
functions.description: Allocates a streaming decompression tracking context to decode dependent blocks.
requirements: Available only when dynamic allocation isn’t disabled.
Returns NULL on allocation failure; free with LZ4_freeStreamDecode().

functions.name: LZ4_freeStreamDecode
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_freeStreamDecode(LZ4_streamDecode_t* LZ4_stream);
functions.description: Frees a streaming decompression tracking context created by LZ4_createStreamDecode().
requirements: LZ4_stream must be a pointer returned by LZ4_createStreamDecode() or NULL.
Available only when dynamic allocation isn’t disabled.
Return value: implementation-defined (commonly 0).

functions.name: LZ4_setStreamDecode
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_setStreamDecode(LZ4_streamDecode_t* LZ4_streamDecode, const char* dictionary, int dictSize);
functions.description: Initializes or resets a streaming decompression context with an optional dictionary to start decoding a new stream of dependent blocks.
requirements: LZ4_streamDecode must be a valid context (allocated once and reused).
dictionary may be NULL or size 0 to reset; otherwise must remain accessible and unmodified during subsequent decompression.
Returns 1 on success, 0 on error.

functions.name: LZ4_decoderRingBufferSize
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decoderRingBufferSize(int maxBlockSize);
functions.description: Computes the minimum ring-buffer size required for streaming decompression compatible with any source respecting maxBlockSize.
requirements: maxBlockSize must be a valid maximum compressed block size (> 16 bytes suggested by notes).
Returns 0 if maxBlockSize is invalid.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_safe_continue
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decompress_safe_continue(LZ4_streamDecode_t* LZ4_streamDecode, const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity);
functions.description: Safely decompresses a single dependent block in a streaming sequence, allowing matches to reference previously decoded data tracked by LZ4_streamDecode.
requirements: LZ4_streamDecode must have been set up (e.g., via LZ4_setStreamDecode) and track the last decoded data.
src must contain one complete compressed block of size srcSize.
dst must be an already-allocated buffer with capacity dstCapacity >= decompressed size.
The last 64 KB of previously decoded data must remain available and unmodified at their original memory location; if less than 64 KB decoded so far, all prior data must remain available.
For ring-buffer usage, one of the documented size/synchronization conditions must be met; otherwise, save last 64 KB externally and set via LZ4_setStreamDecode().
Returns negative on malformed input or if dstCapacity is too small.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_safe_usingDict
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decompress_safe_usingDict(const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity, const char* dictStart, int dictSize);
functions.description: Stateless safe decompression using an explicit dictionary segment representing past data. Equivalent to setStreamDecode + decompress_continue, but without persistent state.
requirements: src must contain one complete compressed block of size srcSize.
dst must be preallocated with capacity dstCapacity (upper bound of decompressed size).
dictStart may be NULL if dictSize is 0; otherwise must point to stable memory for the duration of the call.
Performance tip: faster when dst == dictStart + dictSize.
Returns negative on malformed input or insufficient dstCapacity.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_safe_partial_usingDict
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decompress_safe_partial_usingDict(const char* src, char* dst, int compressedSize, int targetOutputSize, int maxOutputSize, const char* dictStart, int dictSize);
functions.description: Partially decompresses a block using an explicit dictionary, producing up to targetOutputSize bytes (<= maxOutputSize). Returns bytes produced or negative on malformed input.
requirements: dst must be preallocated with capacity maxOutputSize; targetOutputSize <= maxOutputSize.
compressedSize is the size of the compressed block provided in src.
dictStart/dictSize as in LZ4_decompress_safe_usingDict; may be NULL/0 to omit.
Performance tip: faster when dst == dictStart + dictSize.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_fast_extState_fastReset
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_STATIC_API int LZ4_compress_fast_extState_fastReset(void* state, const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity, int acceleration);
functions.description: Static-linking-only variant of extState compression that performs a fast state reset instead of a full initialization, assuming the state is already correctly initialized.
requirements: Accessible only when LZ4_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY is defined (and possibly published).
state must already be correctly initialized for fast reset (per LZ4_resetStream_fast semantics) and be at least LZ4_sizeofState() bytes, 8-byte aligned.
Other requirements identical to LZ4_compress_fast_extState (valid src/dst, sizes, acceleration).

functions.name: LZ4_compress_destSize_extState
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_destSize_extState(void* state, const char* src, char* dst, int* srcSizePtr, int targetDstSize, int acceleration);
functions.description: Static-linking-only function. Like LZ4_compress_destSize but uses an external state and exposes acceleration.
requirements: Accessible only when LZ4_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY is defined.
state must point to a properly sized/initialized state buffer (>= LZ4_sizeofState(), 8-byte aligned).
dst must have at least targetDstSize bytes (targetDstSize >= 1).
*srcSizePtr provides available src bytes and is updated with the number consumed.
acceleration parameter follows LZ4_compress_fast rules.

functions.name: LZ4_initStream
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API LZ4_stream_t* LZ4_initStream(void* stateBuffer, size_t size);
functions.description: Initializes a caller-provided buffer as an LZ4_stream_t for compression. Returns a properly-typed pointer on success, or NULL if size/alignment are insufficient.
requirements: stateBuffer must point to a buffer of at least LZ4_STREAM_MINSIZE bytes with proper alignment.
size must match the provided buffer size.
Must be called before using a stack/externally-allocated LZ4_stream_t that wasn’t created by LZ4_createStream().

functions.name: LZ4_compress
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_compress(const char* src, char* dest, int srcSize);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.7.3. Old compression API; use LZ4_compress_default().
requirements: src must point to srcSize readable bytes.
dest must have enough capacity; this API doesn’t take capacity, so caller must ensure space (e.g., >= LZ4_compressBound(srcSize)).
Prefer using LZ4_compress_default().

functions.name: LZ4_compress_limitedOutput
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_compress_limitedOutput(const char* src, char* dest, int srcSize, int maxOutputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.7.3. Old limited-output compression API; use LZ4_compress_default() or LZ4_compress_fast().
requirements: dest must be preallocated with size maxOutputSize.
Returns 0 if compressed data doesn’t fit in maxOutputSize.
Prefer modern APIs.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_withState
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_compress_withState(void* state, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.7.3. Old external-state compression API; use LZ4_compress_fast_extState().
requirements: state must be a properly allocated state buffer (size and alignment unspecified here; prefer modern LZ4_sizeofState()).
dest must have sufficient capacity (not provided to the function).

functions.name: LZ4_compress_limitedOutput_withState
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_compress_limitedOutput_withState(void* state, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int maxOutputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.7.3. Old external-state limited-output compression API; use LZ4_compress_fast_extState().
requirements: state must be a valid state buffer.
dest must be preallocated with size maxOutputSize.
Returns 0 if output doesn’t fit.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_continue
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_compress_continue(LZ4_stream_t* LZ4_streamPtr, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.7.3. Old streaming compression API; use LZ4_compress_fast_continue().
requirements: LZ4_streamPtr must be a valid streaming context.
dest must have enough capacity (not specified).

functions.name: LZ4_compress_limitedOutput_continue
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_compress_limitedOutput_continue(LZ4_stream_t* LZ4_streamPtr, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int maxOutputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.7.3. Old streaming limited-output API; use LZ4_compress_fast_continue().
requirements: LZ4_streamPtr must be valid.
dest must be at least maxOutputSize; returns 0 if it doesn’t fit.

functions.name: LZ4_uncompress
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_uncompress(const char* source, char* dest, int outputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.8.0. Old fast decompression API; use LZ4_decompress_fast() or (preferably) LZ4_decompress_safe().
requirements: dest must be preallocated with size >= outputSize.
Unsafe vs malformed inputs; prefer safe APIs.

functions.name: LZ4_uncompress_unknownOutputSize
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_uncompress_unknownOutputSize(const char* source, char* dest, int isize, int maxOutputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.8.0. Old safe decompression API; use LZ4_decompress_safe().
requirements: source size is isize; dest capacity is maxOutputSize.
Prefer LZ4_decompress_safe().

functions.name: LZ4_create
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API void* LZ4_create(char* inputBuffer);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.7.0. Obsolete streaming compression constructor; use LZ4_createStream().
requirements: Do not use for new code; degraded functionality (no history retained between calls).

functions.name: LZ4_sizeofStreamState
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_sizeofStreamState(void);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.7.0. Obsolete function related to old streaming API.
requirements: Do not use for new code; use modern streaming APIs.

functions.name: LZ4_resetStreamState
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_resetStreamState(void* state, char* inputBuffer);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.7.0. Obsolete streaming reset; use LZ4_resetStream_fast() or LZ4_initStream().
requirements: state/inputBuffer semantics are from deprecated API; avoid in new code.

functions.name: LZ4_slideInputBuffer
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API char* LZ4_slideInputBuffer(void* state);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.7.0. Obsolete streaming function; use LZ4_saveDict() instead.
requirements: state from deprecated API; avoid in new code.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_safe_withPrefix64k
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decompress_safe_withPrefix64k(const char* src, char* dst, int compressedSize, int maxDstSize);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.7.0. Safe decompression assuming a 64 KB prefix history; use LZ4_decompress_safe_usingDict().
requirements: src contains one block of size compressedSize.
dst capacity is maxDstSize.
Prefer modern dict-based functions.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_fast_withPrefix64k
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decompress_fast_withPrefix64k(const char* src, char* dst, int originalSize);
functions.description: Deprecated since v1.7.0. Fast decompression with 64 KB prefix; use LZ4_decompress_fast_usingDict() or safe variants.
requirements: dst must be preallocated with size >= originalSize.
Unsafe vs malformed input; deprecated.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_fast
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decompress_fast(const char* src, char* dst, int originalSize);
functions.description: Deprecated and unsafe since v1.9.0. Fast decompression without knowing compressed size. May read beyond input if data is malformed. Prefer LZ4_decompress_safe_partial().
requirements: dst must have capacity >= originalSize.
Only use with trusted, well-formed input. Returns compressed size read, or negative on error.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_fast_continue
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decompress_fast_continue(LZ4_streamDecode_t* LZ4_streamDecode, const char* src, char* dst, int originalSize);
functions.description: Deprecated and unsafe since v1.9.0. Streaming fast decompression without compressed size. Prefer LZ4_decompress_safe_continue().
requirements: dst capacity >= originalSize.
LZ4_streamDecode must track previous data.
Only for trusted inputs; may read beyond src on malformed data.

functions.name: LZ4_decompress_fast_usingDict
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API int LZ4_decompress_fast_usingDict(const char* src, char* dst, int originalSize, const char* dictStart, int dictSize);
functions.description: Deprecated and unsafe since v1.9.0. Fast decompression with explicit dictionary. Prefer LZ4_decompress_safe_partial_usingDict().
requirements: dst capacity >= originalSize.
dictStart/dictSize provide dictionary; unsafe for untrusted inputs.

functions.name: LZ4_resetStream
functions.signature: LZ4LIB_API void LZ4_resetStream(LZ4_stream_t* streamPtr);
functions.description: Resets a streaming compression context. Deprecated in favor of LZ4_initStream(); may trigger deprecation warnings in the future.
requirements: streamPtr must be a valid LZ4_stream_t.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_HC
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_HC(const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Compresses src into dst using the high-compression (HC) LZ4 algorithm. Use when you need better compression ratio at the cost of speed. Returns number of bytes written to dst, or 0 on failure.
requirements: dst must be preallocated by the caller.
Compression is guaranteed to succeed if dstCapacity >= LZ4_compressBound(srcSize).
srcSize must be <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE (see lz4.h).
compressionLevel: any value between 1 and LZ4HC_CLEVEL_MAX works; values > LZ4HC_CLEVEL_MAX behave like LZ4HC_CLEVEL_MAX.
On failure the function returns 0; callers must handle this case.

functions.name: LZ4_sizeofStateHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_sizeofStateHC(void);
functions.description: Returns the size in bytes required to hold an HC compression state for use with LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC().
requirements: Use the returned size to allocate an external state buffer for LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC().
The external state memory must be 8-byte aligned (typical malloc() satisfies this).

functions.name: LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC(void* stateHC, const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int maxDstSize, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Compresses src into dst using a caller-provided external HC state buffer instead of internal allocation. Returns number of bytes written to dst, or 0 on failure.
requirements: stateHC must point to a buffer of at least LZ4_sizeofStateHC() bytes.
stateHC must be 8-byte aligned.
dst must be preallocated and have capacity maxDstSize.
Compression success is not guaranteed unless maxDstSize >= LZ4_compressBound(srcSize).
srcSize must be <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE (see lz4.h).
compressionLevel in [1, LZ4HC_CLEVEL_MAX]; values above act as LZ4HC_CLEVEL_MAX.
On failure the function returns 0; callers must handle this case.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_HC_destSize
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_HC_destSize(void* stateHC, const char* src, char* dst, int* srcSizePtr, int targetDstSize, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Compresses as much of src as will fit into targetDstSize bytes in dst, using an external HC state. Returns bytes written (<= targetDstSize), or 0 on failure. On success, *srcSizePtr is updated to the number of input bytes consumed.
requirements: stateHC must point to a correctly sized and 8-byte aligned HC state buffer (size from LZ4_sizeofStateHC()).
dst must be preallocated with capacity >= targetDstSize.
srcSizePtr must be a valid pointer to an int; on success it is updated with the number of input bytes read.
compressionLevel in [1, LZ4HC_CLEVEL_MAX]; values above behave like LZ4HC_CLEVEL_MAX.
May not consume the entire input; caller must check updated *srcSizePtr.
On failure returns 0; callers must handle this case.

functions.name: LZ4_createStreamHC
functions.signature: LZ4_streamHC_t* LZ4_createStreamHC(void);
functions.description: Allocates and returns a new LZ4 HC streaming compression state, initialized and ready to use with the default compression level.
requirements: Caller must later release the state with LZ4_freeStreamHC().
Returned pointer is non-NULL on success; caller must handle allocation failures (unknown return convention for failure: may return NULL).
Newly created state is initialized; no extra init required before first use.

functions.name: LZ4_freeStreamHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_freeStreamHC(LZ4_streamHC_t* streamHCPtr);
functions.description: Releases an LZ4 HC streaming compression state allocated by LZ4_createStreamHC(). Returns an int status (exact convention unspecified in this header).
requirements: streamHCPtr must be a pointer previously returned by LZ4_createStreamHC(), or NULL per typical free semantics (behavior for NULL unspecified in this header).
Caller should not use the state after freeing it.
Caller must handle the integer return value (exact meaning not documented here).

functions.name: LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast
functions.signature: void LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast(LZ4_streamHC_t* streamHCPtr, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Quickly resets an existing, previously-initialized HC stream to start compressing a new sequence of blocks, setting the compression level. Avoids full reinitialization when possible.
requirements: streamHCPtr must refer to a stream that has been properly initialized at least once (e.g., via LZ4_createStreamHC(), LZ4_resetStreamHC(), LZ4_initStreamHC(), memset to zero, or a successful compression/reset as documented).
May be used between blocks to change compressionLevel.
If the stream is in an indeterminate/error state, this call may perform a full reset, clearing history and settings.

functions.name: LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast
functions.signature: void LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast(LZ4_streamHC_t* streamHCPtr, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Quickly resets an LZ4 HC streaming compression context to start a new stream with the specified compression level, reusing internal allocations when the state is already coherent. Typical usage: after finishing a streaming session (or on failure recovery), call this to begin a new sequence of blocks; set the desired compression level here before optionally loading a dictionary with LZ4_loadDictHC(). Note: If the context is not known-good, the implementation may fall back to a full reset. A function with the same name and signature also exists in the static-linking-only section with extended behavioral notes; the API intent is the same.
requirements: streamHCPtr must be a non-null pointer to a valid LZ4_streamHC_t.

The stream must have been properly initialized at least once before using this fast reset. Valid prior states include any of the following (as stated in the header): returned from LZ4_createStreamHC(), reset by LZ4_resetStreamHC(), zero-initialized via memset(stream, 0, sizeof(LZ4_streamHC_t)), previously in a valid state and reset by LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast(), previously in a valid state and used in any compression call that returned success, or in an indeterminate state but then used in a compression call that fully reset the state (LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC()) and returned success.
If the last compression call on this stream returned an error, this function may still be called; it will fully reset the state, clearing any existing history and settings.
Call this function to start a new stream of blocks; do not continue a prior stream’s history after calling it.
Set the desired compression level here before loading a dictionary with LZ4_loadDictHC(); dictionary loading relies on the already-set level (as documented).
compressionLevel may be any integer; values in [1, LZ4HC_CLEVEL_MAX] are supported, and values > LZ4HC_CLEVEL_MAX behave as LZ4HC_CLEVEL_MAX (per header-level notes on compression levels).
After any compression failure, the API does not guarantee recovery; the state must be reset before further use (this function satisfies that requirement).

functions.name: LZ4_loadDictHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_loadDictHC(LZ4_streamHC_t* streamHCPtr, const char* dictionary, int dictSize);
functions.description: Loads an initial dictionary into an HC streaming context to seed future compressions. Returns the dictionary size actually loaded.
requirements: streamHCPtr must be an initialized HC stream.
dictionary must point to read-accessible memory of size dictSize.
Set the desired compression level before calling, to build the correct data structures.
After loading, the dictionary content must remain accessible and unmodified while referenced by subsequent compressions.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_HC_continue
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_HC_continue(LZ4_streamHC_t* streamHCPtr, const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int maxDstSize);
functions.description: Compresses a block as part of an HC streaming session, using prior blocks (and optional dictionary) as history. Returns number of bytes written or 0 on failure.
requirements: streamHCPtr must be an initialized HC streaming state.
Previous input blocks (up to 64 KB) used as history must remain accessible and unmodified during compression; ring buffers smaller than 64 KB are handled.
dst must be preallocated with capacity maxDstSize; for guaranteed success, size it to LZ4_compressBound(srcSize).
On failure, recovery is not guaranteed; the state must be reset.
srcSize may be any block size; src must be readable for srcSize bytes.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_HC_continue_destSize
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_HC_continue_destSize(LZ4_streamHC_t* LZ4_streamHCPtr, const char* src, char* dst, int* srcSizePtr, int targetDstSize);
functions.description: Streaming variant that compresses as much input as will fit into targetDstSize bytes of dst. Returns bytes written (<= targetDstSize) or 0 on failure. On success, *srcSizePtr is updated with the number of input bytes consumed; may be less than the provided input.
requirements: LZ4_streamHCPtr must be an initialized HC streaming state with valid history (if any).
dst must be preallocated to at least targetDstSize.
srcSizePtr must be a valid pointer to an int; on success updated to bytes read; function may not consume all input.
If previous input cannot remain in-place, consider persisting history via LZ4_saveDictHC().
On failure, state recovery is not guaranteed; reset the stream.

functions.name: LZ4_saveDictHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_saveDictHC(LZ4_streamHC_t* streamHCPtr, char* safeBuffer, int maxDictSize);
functions.description: Saves up to maxDictSize bytes of the most recent history from a streaming context into safeBuffer for later reuse as a dictionary. Returns the number of bytes saved (<= 64 KB).
requirements: streamHCPtr must be an HC streaming state.
safeBuffer must point to writable memory of size at least maxDictSize.
The returned size is <= 64 KB; caller should handle any size up to that limit.
Use this when previous blocks cannot remain in-place during subsequent compressions.

functions.name: LZ4_attach_HC_dictionary
functions.signature: void LZ4_attach_HC_dictionary(LZ4_streamHC_t* working_stream, const LZ4_streamHC_t* dictionary_stream);
functions.description: Attaches a prepared dictionary stream to a working stream without copying, enabling efficient reuse of a static dictionary for the current session. Passing NULL detaches any existing dictionary.
requirements: dictionary_stream should be a stream prepared by LZ4_loadDictHC(); other states are not guaranteed to work.
Only attach to a working_stream with no history (i.e., just reset).
The dictionary stream and its source buffer must remain in-place, accessible, and unchanged for the lifetime of the session.
Calling LZ4_resetStreamHC() or LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast() on working_stream removes the attachment.

functions.name: LZ4_initStreamHC
functions.signature: LZ4_streamHC_t* LZ4_initStreamHC(void* buffer, size_t size);
functions.description: Initializes a statically allocated buffer as an LZ4 HC streaming state and returns it as LZ4_streamHC_t*. Use for static allocation scenarios instead of dynamic allocation.
requirements: buffer must point to writable memory intended to hold an LZ4_streamHC_t.
size must be at least sizeof(LZ4_streamHC_t) (exact required size not specified here; function returns the stream pointer on success).
Only use with static linking; preferred dynamic path is LZ4_createStreamHC().
Do not call on memory containing arbitrary garbage without proper size; this function performs initialization.

functions.name: LZ4_compressHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressHC(const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated alias of LZ4_compress_HC() without an explicit compression level and without an explicit dst capacity parameter. Provided for backward compatibility.
requirements: dest must be preallocated.
Deprecated: prefer LZ4_compress_HC().
Caller must handle 0 return on failure (inferred from modern API semantics; exact behavior of this deprecated function is not restated here).

functions.name: LZ4_compressHC_limitedOutput
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressHC_limitedOutput(const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int maxOutputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated limited-output HC compression. Attempts to compress up to inputSize bytes into at most maxOutputSize bytes.
requirements: dest must be preallocated with capacity maxOutputSize.
Deprecated: use LZ4_compress_HC() or destSize variants instead.
Caller must handle failure indicated by return value (details not restated here).

functions.name: LZ4_compressHC2
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressHC2(const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Deprecated HC compression with explicit compression level.
requirements: dest must be preallocated.
compressionLevel must be within supported range (unspecified here; use modern constants as guidance).
Deprecated: use LZ4_compress_HC().

functions.name: LZ4_compressHC2_limitedOutput
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressHC2_limitedOutput(const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int maxOutputSize, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Deprecated HC compression with explicit compression level and limited output size.
requirements: dest must be preallocated with capacity maxOutputSize.
Deprecated: use LZ4_compress_HC() or destSize variants.
Caller must handle possible failure if output limit is insufficient.

functions.name: LZ4_compressHC_withStateHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressHC_withStateHC(void* state, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated HC compression using a caller-provided state buffer (size and alignment details not restated here).
requirements: state must point to an appropriately sized and aligned HC state buffer (see modern LZ4_sizeofStateHC requirements).
dest must be preallocated.
Deprecated: use LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC().

functions.name: LZ4_compressHC_limitedOutput_withStateHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressHC_limitedOutput_withStateHC(void* state, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int maxOutputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated limited-output HC compression using caller-provided state.
requirements: state must be a valid HC state buffer.
dest must be preallocated with capacity maxOutputSize.
Deprecated: use LZ4_compress_HC_destSize() or LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC().

functions.name: LZ4_compressHC2_withStateHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressHC2_withStateHC(void* state, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Deprecated HC compression with state and explicit compression level.
requirements: state must be a valid HC state buffer.
dest must be preallocated.
Deprecated: use LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC().

functions.name: LZ4_compressHC2_limitedOutput_withStateHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressHC2_limitedOutput_withStateHC(void* state, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int maxOutputSize, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Deprecated limited-output HC compression with state and explicit compression level.
requirements: state must be a valid HC state buffer.
dest must be preallocated with capacity maxOutputSize.
Deprecated: prefer LZ4_compress_HC_destSize() or modern APIs.

functions.name: LZ4_compressHC_continue
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressHC_continue(LZ4_streamHC_t* LZ4_streamHCPtr, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated streaming HC compression of a block, using prior history from the stream.
requirements: LZ4_streamHCPtr must be an initialized HC stream.
dest must be preallocated.
Deprecated: use LZ4_compress_HC_continue().

functions.name: LZ4_compressHC_limitedOutput_continue
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressHC_limitedOutput_continue(LZ4_streamHC_t* LZ4_streamHCPtr, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int maxOutputSize);
functions.description: Deprecated streaming HC compression with a maximum output size for the block.
requirements: LZ4_streamHCPtr must be initialized.
dest must be preallocated with capacity maxOutputSize.
Deprecated: use LZ4_compress_HC_continue_destSize() or the non-limited variant.

functions.name: LZ4_createHC
functions.signature: void* LZ4_createHC(const char* inputBuffer);
functions.description: Obsolete function that allocated a streaming HC state tied to an input buffer. Kept for compatibility; functionality is degraded and not recommended.
requirements: Only available when memory allocation is enabled (not defined LZ4_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY_DISABLE_MEMORY_ALLOCATION).
Deprecated/obsolete: use LZ4_createStreamHC() instead.
Behavior depends on legacy expectations; using LZ4_slideInputBufferHC() truncates history.

functions.name: LZ4_freeHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_freeHC(void* LZ4HC_Data);
functions.description: Obsolete function to free a state created by LZ4_createHC().
requirements: LZ4HC_Data must be a pointer returned by LZ4_createHC().
Deprecated/obsolete: use LZ4_freeStreamHC() instead.

functions.name: LZ4_slideInputBufferHC
functions.signature: char* LZ4_slideInputBufferHC(void* LZ4HC_Data);
functions.description: Obsolete function intended to slide the input buffer window of an HC stream. Now degrades by truncating history; do not use for new code.
requirements: LZ4HC_Data must be a valid legacy HC stream pointer.
Deprecated/obsolete: use LZ4_saveDictHC() with modern streaming API instead.

functions.name: LZ4_compressHC2_continue
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressHC2_continue(void* LZ4HC_Data, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Obsolete streaming HC compression with explicit compression level on legacy state.
requirements: LZ4HC_Data must be a valid legacy HC stream.
dest must be preallocated.
Deprecated/obsolete: use LZ4_compress_HC_continue() with modern streams.

functions.name: LZ4_compressHC2_limitedOutput_continue
functions.signature: int LZ4_compressHC2_limitedOutput_continue(void* LZ4HC_Data, const char* source, char* dest, int inputSize, int maxOutputSize, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Obsolete streaming HC compression with a maximum output size on legacy state.
requirements: LZ4HC_Data must be a valid legacy HC stream.
dest must be preallocated with capacity maxOutputSize.
Deprecated/obsolete: prefer LZ4_compress_HC_continue_destSize().

functions.name: LZ4_sizeofStreamStateHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_sizeofStreamStateHC(void);
functions.description: Obsolete function returning the size of a legacy HC stream state.
requirements: Deprecated/obsolete: use LZ4_sizeofStateHC() for modern APIs.

functions.name: LZ4_resetStreamStateHC
functions.signature: int LZ4_resetStreamStateHC(void* state, char* inputBuffer);
functions.description: Obsolete function to reset a legacy HC stream state tied to an input buffer.
requirements: state must refer to a legacy HC stream state.
Deprecated/obsolete: use LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast() or LZ4_initStreamHC() with modern streams.

functions.name: LZ4_resetStreamHC
functions.signature: void LZ4_resetStreamHC(LZ4_streamHC_t* streamHCPtr, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Initializes or fully resets an HC streaming context and sets the compression level. Superseded by LZ4_initStreamHC() for first-use initialization; kept for compatibility.
requirements: streamHCPtr must be a valid LZ4_streamHC_t pointer.
Use this for full reset/initialization; for fast reset between sessions, prefer LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast() when permitted.

functions.name: LZ4_setCompressionLevel
functions.signature: void LZ4_setCompressionLevel(LZ4_streamHC_t* LZ4_streamHCPtr, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Experimental (static-linking-only) API to change the compression level of an HC streaming context between blocks.
requirements: Available only when LZ4_HC_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY is defined (static linking).
Call between successive LZ4_compress_HC_continue*() calls within the same stream.
compressionLevel must be within supported range.

functions.name: LZ4_favorDecompressionSpeed
functions.signature: void LZ4_favorDecompressionSpeed(LZ4_streamHC_t* LZ4_streamHCPtr, int favor);
functions.description: Experimental (static-linking-only) API to bias the parser towards decompression speed at the cost of compression ratio. Applicable only for levels >= LZ4HC_CLEVEL_OPT_MIN.
requirements: Available only when LZ4_HC_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY is defined (static linking).
favor is a flag value; non-zero enables the behavior.
Only applicable when current compression level is >= LZ4HC_CLEVEL_OPT_MIN.

functions.name: LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC_fastReset
functions.signature: int LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC_fastReset(void* state, const char* src, char* dst, int srcSize, int dstCapacity, int compressionLevel);
functions.description: Experimental (static-linking-only) variant of LZ4_compress_HC_extStateHC() that uses a fast reset of an already correctly initialized state to avoid the expensive full reset. Returns number of bytes written or 0 on failure.
requirements: Available only when LZ4_HC_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY is defined (static linking).
state must be already correctly initialized (i.e., in a state acceptable for LZ4_resetStreamHC_fast()).
dst must be preallocated with capacity dstCapacity; for guaranteed success, ensure dstCapacity >= LZ4_compressBound(srcSize).
srcSize must be <= LZ4_MAX_INPUT_SIZE.
compressionLevel in [1, LZ4HC_CLEVEL_MAX]; higher values behave like max.
On failure returns 0; callers must handle this case.

functions.name: LZ4F_isError
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API unsigned LZ4F_isError(LZ4F_errorCode_t code);
functions.description: Tests whether a returned size_t value from an LZ4F API is an error code. Returns non-zero if the value represents an error. Use after functions that return size_t to distinguish success from failure.
requirements: Argument code should be a value returned by an LZ4F function that reports errors via size_t (e.g., LZ4F_compressFrame, LZ4F_decompress, etc.).
Caller must interpret non-zero return as error and may obtain a message via LZ4F_getErrorName().

functions.name: LZ4F_getErrorName
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API const char* LZ4F_getErrorName(LZ4F_errorCode_t code);
functions.description: Returns a human-readable string describing the error code. Useful for logging and debugging when LZ4F_isError() indicates a failure.
requirements: Argument code should be an error code previously returned by an LZ4F API or obtained via LZ4F_getErrorCode().
Returned pointer is to a static string; do not free.

functions.name: LZ4F_compressFrame
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API size_t LZ4F_compressFrame(void* dstBuffer, size_t dstCapacity, const void* srcBuffer, size_t srcSize, const LZ4F_preferences_t* preferencesPtr);
functions.description: Compresses the entire srcBuffer into a single LZ4 frame in one shot. Stateless (no context required). Returns the number of bytes written or an error code (check with LZ4F_isError()).
requirements: dstCapacity MUST be >= LZ4F_compressFrameBound(srcSize, preferencesPtr).
preferencesPtr may be NULL to use default preferences.
On error (LZ4F_isError(ret) != 0), no additional state exists to clean up (stateless), but the returned value must be checked before using output.

functions.name: LZ4F_compressFrameBound
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API size_t LZ4F_compressFrameBound(size_t srcSize, const LZ4F_preferences_t* preferencesPtr);
functions.description: Returns the maximum possible size of a frame produced by LZ4F_compressFrame() for the given srcSize and preferences. Use to size destination buffers safely.
requirements: preferencesPtr may be NULL to assume default preferences.
Result is only guaranteed for LZ4F_compressFrame(); for streaming it applies only if no flush operation is performed.

functions.name: LZ4F_compressionLevel_max
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API int LZ4F_compressionLevel_max(void);
functions.description: Returns the maximum allowed compression level supported by the library (currently 12).

functions.name: LZ4F_getVersion
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API unsigned LZ4F_getVersion(void);
functions.description: Returns the LZ4F API version number (compare against LZ4F_VERSION) to detect ABI/API compatibility.

functions.name: LZ4F_createCompressionContext
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API LZ4F_errorCode_t LZ4F_createCompressionContext(LZ4F_cctx** cctxPtr, unsigned version);
functions.description: Allocates and initializes a streaming compression context for use with advanced compression APIs. Writes the created context pointer to *cctxPtr. Returns 0 on success or an error code.
requirements: version MUST be LZ4F_VERSION.
cctxPtr MUST be non-NULL.
On non-zero return, context creation failed and *cctxPtr is not a valid context.
A created context can be reused for multiple streaming operations; release with LZ4F_freeCompressionContext() when done.

functions.name: LZ4F_freeCompressionContext
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API LZ4F_errorCode_t LZ4F_freeCompressionContext(LZ4F_cctx* cctx);
functions.description: Releases a compression context previously created. Always succeeds and is safe to call with NULL.
requirements: It is safe to pass NULL (no-op).
Return value can be ignored (always successful).

functions.name: LZ4F_compressBegin
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API size_t LZ4F_compressBegin(LZ4F_cctx* cctx, void* dstBuffer, size_t dstCapacity, const LZ4F_preferences_t* prefsPtr);
functions.description: Initializes a streaming compression operation and writes the frame header to dstBuffer. Returns the number of header bytes written or an error code.
requirements: cctx must be a valid compression context created by LZ4F_createCompressionContext().
dstCapacity MUST be >= LZ4F_HEADER_SIZE_MAX.
prefsPtr may be NULL to use defaults.
On error, the result is an error code (test with LZ4F_isError()).

functions.name: LZ4F_compressBound
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API size_t LZ4F_compressBound(size_t srcSize, const LZ4F_preferences_t* prefsPtr);
functions.description: Computes the minimum dstCapacity required to guarantee a single LZ4F_compressUpdate() call with srcSize bytes will succeed in the worst case. For srcSize==0, returns an upper bound for LZ4F_flush() and LZ4F_compressEnd().
requirements: prefsPtr may be NULL; defaults will cover worst-case.
Result does not include the frame header; header must be produced by LZ4F_compressBegin() separately.
If the output buffer is not reset between updates, ensure remaining capacity is checked before each call using this function.

functions.name: LZ4F_compressUpdate
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API size_t LZ4F_compressUpdate(LZ4F_cctx* cctx, void* dstBuffer, size_t dstCapacity, const void* srcBuffer, size_t srcSize, const LZ4F_compressOptions_t* cOptPtr);
functions.description: Continues a streaming compression, consuming up to srcSize bytes and appending compressed data to dstBuffer. May buffer data internally and return 0. Returns bytes written or an error code.
requirements: cctx must be a valid context initialized by LZ4F_compressBegin().
dstCapacity MUST be large enough for the worst case; use LZ4F_compressBound(srcSize, prefsPtr).
If this capacity requirement is not met, the call fails with an error code.
After an error, the state is left undefined; it must be re-initialized or freed before reuse.
If an uncompressed block was previously written, buffered data is flushed before resuming compressed output.
cOptPtr may be NULL to use default options.

functions.name: LZ4F_flush
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API size_t LZ4F_flush(LZ4F_cctx* cctx, void* dstBuffer, size_t dstCapacity, const LZ4F_compressOptions_t* cOptPtr);
functions.description: Forces any buffered input within cctx to be compressed and emitted immediately, without waiting for a full block. Returns bytes written (possibly 0) or an error code.
requirements: cctx must be a valid compression context previously begun with LZ4F_compressBegin().
dstCapacity must be large enough to ensure success; it is guaranteed to succeed when dstCapacity >= LZ4F_compressBound(0, prefsPtr).
cOptPtr may be NULL for defaults.

functions.name: LZ4F_compressEnd
functions.signature: LZ4FLIB_API size_t LZ4F_compressEnd(LZ4F_cctx* cctx, void* dstBuffer, size_t dstCapacity, const LZ4F_compressOptions_t* cOptPtr);
functions.description: Finalizes a streaming compression: flushes any buffered data, writes the endMark and optional checksum. Returns bytes written (>= 4) or an error code. On success, the context may be reused for another compression task.
requirements: cctx must be a valid compression context for the active frame.
dstCapacity must be large enough; guaranteed success when dstCapacity >= LZ4F_compressBound(0, prefsPtr).

A byte buffer containing one complete LZ4 compressed block (not a full frame), suitable for LZ4_*decompress*_ APIs that expect a single block and a provided destination capacity or target size.

generators.generator:
import random
import struct
import zlib

# This generator produces a valid single LZ4-compressed block (not a full frame),
# so that LZ4_*decompress*_ APIs expecting a block can successfully decode it.
# It implements enough of the LZ4 block format to generate diverse, correct inputs.
#
# Strategy
# - Build an uncompressed source buffer with varied patterns to exercise matches and literals.
# - Encode it as a single LZ4 block consisting of a sequence of tokens and LZ4 copies.
# - Occasionally emit only literals (no matches) for very small payloads to exercise edge cases.
# - Respect maximum match length encodings (including 0xFF extension bytes) and offsets.
# - Keep block size <= 4 KiB to match fuzzer destinations.
#
# References (format overview):
# - Each sequence: token (litLen in high nibble, matchLen in low nibble), optional literal bytes,
#   2-byte little-endian offset (if there is a match), then optional extra length bytes if litLen or matchLen >= 15.
# - matchLen in token encodes (match_length - 4).
# - The last sequence may contain only literals (no offset), which is a valid block termination.


MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES = 4096


def _rand_bytes(rng: random.Random, n: int) -> bytes:
    return bytes(rng.getrandbits(8) for _ in range(n))


def _make_source(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Compose a source buffer with patterns to enable useful matches:
    # - ASCII text, repeated substrings, zero runs, random data, small dictionary-like prefixes.
    chunks = []
    # Small dictionary prefix
    dict_chunk = b"LZ4DICT:" + b"ABCD" * rng.randint(2, 8)
    chunks.append(dict_chunk)
    # Repeated phrase with variations
    phrase = (b"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. ")
    rep = rng.randint(1, 10)
    chunks.append(phrase * rep)
    # Zero run
    zeros = bytes([0]) * rng.randint(0, 128)
    chunks.append(zeros)
    # Random noise
    rnd = _rand_bytes(rng, rng.randint(0, 256))
    chunks.append(rnd)
    # Numeric pattern
    nums = (b"1234567890" * rng.randint(0, 20))
    chunks.append(nums)
    # Small variant copies to encourage matches
    if len(phrase) > 0:
        tail_rep = rng.randint(0, 5)
        chunks.append(phrase[:rng.randint(5, len(phrase))] * tail_rep)
    # Ensure non-empty, cap total size
    data = b"".join(chunks)
    # Trim to a reasonable size to keep compressed block <= 4KiB comfortably
    max_src = 2000  # generous upper bound for this generator
    if len(data) == 0:
        data = b"A"
    if len(data) > max_src:
        data = data[:max_src]
    # Occasionally produce very small buffers
    if rng.random() < 0.1:
        data = _rand_bytes(rng, rng.randint(1, 64))
    return data


def _emit_length(n: int) -> bytes:
    # Emit LZ4 length extension bytes for n >= 15 (for literals or match extra).
    out = bytearray()
    while n >= 255:
        out.append(255)
        n -= 255
    out.append(n)
    return bytes(out)


def _compress_lz4_block(src: bytes, rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Very simple greedy LZ4 encoder sufficient for valid output.
    # Uses a small rolling hash to find matches in a dictionary window.
    n = len(src)
    i = 0
    out = bytearray()
    # Hash table: map 3-byte sequences to last position (like a very small dictionary)
    last_pos = {}

    def hash3(val: int) -> int:
        # Simple multiplicative hash on 24-bit value
        return (val * 2654435761) & ((1 << 20) - 1)  # 1M buckets implicit by dict size control via Python dict

    # Helper to read 3 bytes as int
    def read3(p: int) -> int:
        if p + 3 <= n:
            b0, b1, b2 = src[p], src[p+1], src[p+2]
            return b0 | (b1 << 8) | (b2 << 16)
        else:
            # pad for tail, won't be used for matching meaningful lengths
            val = 0
            for k in range(3):
                if p + k < n:
                    val |= src[p+k] << (8*k)
            return val

    # Probability to force literal-only block (valid termination) for variety
    literal_only = (n <= 64 and rng.random() < 0.25)

    # Build sequences
    while i < n:
        if literal_only:
            # Encode remainder as final literal-only sequence and finish
            lit_len = n - i
            token_lit = 15 if lit_len >= 15 else lit_len
            token = (token_lit << 4)
            out.append(token)
            if token_lit == 15:
                out += _emit_length(lit_len - 15)
            out += src[i:]
            i = n
            break

        # Attempt to find a match of at least 4 bytes
        match_pos = -1
        match_len = 0
        if i + 4 <= n:
            key = hash3(read3(i))
            prev = last_pos.get(key, -1)
            # Insert current position early so immediate repeats can reference it next time
            last_pos[key] = i
            # Check potential match within 64KB window
            if prev >= 0 and (i - prev) <= 0xFFFF:
                # Extend match
                p = prev
                q = i
                # Require at least 4-byte match to encode
                # First ensure first 4 bytes match
                if q + 4 <= n and p + 4 <= n and src[p:p+4] == src[q:q+4]:
                    match_len = 4
                    p += 4
                    q += 4
                    # Extend further
                    while q < n and p < n and src[p] == src[q] and match_len < 0xFFFF + 4:
                        match_len += 1
                        p += 1
                        q += 1
                    match_pos = prev
        # If no match or match too small, output a literal and advance
        if match_len < 4:
            # Output as part of next sequence; we may accumulate a run of literals before a match
            # To simplify, we buffer literals until we either hit a match or reach end or a limit.
            lit_start = i
            lit_end = min(n, i + rng.randint(1, 32))  # small literal run
            # Update hash table while we advance
            j = i
            while j < lit_end and j + 2 < n:
                last_pos[hash3(read3(j))] = j
                j += 1
            i = lit_end
            # If we reached end, emit final literal-only sequence
            if i >= n:
                lit_len = i - lit_start
                token_lit = 15 if lit_len >= 15 else lit_len
                out.append(token_lit << 4)
                if token_lit == 15:
                    out += _emit_length(lit_len - 15)
                out += src[lit_start:i]
                break
            else:
                # Try to find a match at new position
                # Compute match at i again (next loop), but we need to flush the literals now
                lit_len = i - lit_start
                token_lit = 15 if lit_len >= 15 else lit_len
                token = (token_lit << 4)  # match part 0 for now; we will add match next iteration
                # We need a match to complete a sequence that includes an offset, but since we didn't find one yet,
                # we will search now and emit a match right after the literals if possible.
                # If none is found immediately, we will emit literals-only now and continue.
                # Check for match at current i
                match_pos2 = -1
                match_len2 = 0
                if i + 4 <= n:
                    k = hash3(read3(i))
                    prev2 = last_pos.get(k, -1)
                    last_pos[k] = i
                    if prev2 >= 0 and (i - prev2) <= 0xFFFF:
                        if src[prev2:prev2+4] == src[i:i+4]:
                            p = prev2 + 4
                            q = i + 4
                            match_len2 = 4
                            while q < n and p < n and src[p] == src[q] and match_len2 < 0xFFFF + 4:
                                match_len2 += 1
                                p += 1
                                q += 1
                            match_pos2 = prev2
                if match_len2 >= 4:
                    # Complete sequence: literals + match
                    mlen = match_len2
                    mtoken = mlen - 4
                    if mtoken > 15:
                        mtoken_base = 15
                    else:
                        mtoken_base = mtoken
                    token |= mtoken_base
                    out.append(token)
                    if token_lit == 15:
                        out += _emit_length(lit_len - 15)
                    out += src[lit_start:i]
                    # offset
                    offset = i - match_pos2
                    out += struct.pack('<H', offset)
                    # extra match length if needed
                    if mtoken_base == 15:
                        out += _emit_length(mtoken - 15)
                    # Advance i by match_len2 and update hashes along the way
                    j = i + 1
                    end_update = i + mlen - 2
                    while j < end_update and j + 2 < n:
                        last_pos[hash3(read3(j))] = j
                        j += 1
                    i += mlen
                    continue
                else:
                    # Emit literals-only sequence and continue
                    out.append(token)
                    if token_lit == 15:
                        out += _emit_length(lit_len - 15)
                    out += src[lit_start:i]
                    # continue loop from current i
                    continue
        else:
            # We have a match starting at i with length match_len and previous position match_pos
            # Use zero literals for this sequence
            lit_len = 0
            token = 0  # high nibble 0 literals
            mlen = match_len
            mtoken = mlen - 4
            if mtoken > 15:
                token |= 15
            else:
                token |= mtoken
            out.append(token)
            # No literal len extensions and no literal bytes
            # Emit offset
            offset = i - match_pos
            out += struct.pack('<H', offset)
            # Emit extra match length if needed
            if mtoken > 15:
                out += _emit_length(mtoken - 15)
            # Update hashes through the match (except last 2 positions)
            j = i + 1
            end_update = i + mlen - 2
            while j < end_update and j + 2 < n:
                last_pos[hash3(read3(j))] = j
                j += 1
            i += mlen

        # Safety size limit to respect fuzz harness boundaries
        if len(out) > MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES:
            # Truncate by finishing with a literal-only tail if possible
            remaining = n - i
            if remaining > 0:
                lit_len = remaining
                token_lit = 15 if lit_len >= 15 else lit_len
                out.append(token_lit << 4)
                if token_lit == 15:
                    out += _emit_length(lit_len - 15)
                out += src[i:]
            break

    # Ensure block does not exceed limit
    return bytes(out[:MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES])


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Randomly decide to generate:
    # - a valid LZ4 block over crafted source
    # - a small literal-only block
    # - a block designed to need a dictionary (by referencing early data far behind within 64KB)
    mode = rng.random()
    src = _make_source(rng)

    # Occasionally shrink source to ensure dst small buffers can still succeed
    if rng.random() < 0.2 and len(src) > 0:
        src = src[:rng.randint(1, min(512, len(src)))]

    block = _compress_lz4_block(src, rng)

    # Ensure non-empty output (LZ4 block can be empty if src empty; avoid zero-length which is ambiguous for some harnesses)
    if not block:
        # Emit minimal literal-only block with 1 byte
        b = bytes([1 << 4]) + b"A"
        return b

    return block
